name: cavalier_of_night_cannot_return_a_dead_token
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 3 F4b, hunt 2 H2-1; BACKLOG B-112, closed). A 2/2 Wolf token dies while P0 controls Moldervine Reclamation ('Whenever a creature you control dies, you gain 1 life and draw a card'), whose trigger waits on the stack. Then Cavalier of Night dies: 'When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.' CR 704.5d, 111.7-8: the token ceased to exist at the state-based check before the Cavalier's trigger was put on the stack, so it is no legal target; the trigger has none and is removed (CR 603.3d). Both deaths still draw through Moldervine. Failed before the fix: the token, kept in the graveyard as the Moldervine trigger's last-known information, was the Cavalier trigger's only target and came back to the battlefield.
